cards.verse_text: That evening quail came and covered the camp, and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.

cards.card_text: And THEN a wind sent by the LORD comes up and drives in quail from the sea.
cards.verse_text: Now a wind sent by the LORD came up, drove in quail from the sea, and brought them near the camp, about two cubits above the surface of the ground, for a day’s journey in every direction around the camp.

cards.card_text: The people gather the quail for just one morning and then go back to their tents.
cards.verse_text: All that day and night, and all the next day, the people stayed up gathering the quail.
cards.snippet: …night, and all the next day, the people stayed up gathering the quail.

cards.card_text: All that day and night and all the next day, nobody gathers less than ten homers, and they spread the quail out all around the camp.
cards.verse_text: All that day and night, and all the next day, the people stayed up gathering the quail.

cards.card_text: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
